command: python /runner/probe.py && python -m pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation -e . && python /runner/check_compiled.py && for repeat in timing-1 timing-2 timing-3 allocations; do mkdir -p /reports/$repeat; if [ "$repeat" = allocations ]; then extra="--pools 131072 --allocations"; else extra=""; fi; VALIDATION_REPORT=/reports/$repeat python /runner/pool_discovery_profile.py $extra || exit $?; done

cgroup_before.memory.events:
low 0
high 0
max 0
oom 0
oom_kill 0
oom_group_kill 0

cgroup_after.memory.events:
low 0
high 0
max 0
oom 0
oom_kill 0
oom_group_kill 0
